hook: A new Triassic dinosaur skull from South Africa shows early sauropodomorphs grew fast.
summary: Nyana rooiwalensis is a new early sauropodomorph from the Late Triassic, with the first near-complete skull from its rock unit. Bone growth lines show it was young at about 400 kg, hinting at rapid growth early in the group, which later produced giant sauropods. Its exact family position is unresolved between two options, and the growth inference rests on one juvenile.
title: Nyana rooiwalensis: South Africa's earliest near-complete sauropodomorph dinosaur skull from the Late Triassic of the Eastern Cape Province.
